title: Greenfield Allotment Plot Application
contextEn: A resident phones a town council allotment officer to apply for a community garden plot and ask about site regulations.

script.text: Good morning, Greenfield Council Parks and Allotments, Rachel speaking. How may I help?
Hello Rachel. I live in Greenfield and I would like to apply for a vegetable plot on one of the council allotment sites.
Oh, lovely! Growing your own produce has become hugely popular this year. I can register your application right now. Could I start with your full name?
Sure, it is Simon Thornton. Let me spell the surname just in case: T-H-O-R-N-T-O-N.
script.ttsText: Sure, it is Simon Thornton. Let me spell the surname just in case: T, H, O, R, N, T, O, N.

script.text: Thornton, got it. Because council plots are reserved for local residents, could you give me your street address?
Of course, it is 36 Millbrook Road... oh, sorry, 63 Millbrook Road! I always reverse those two digits when I am rushing.
script.ttsText: Of course, it is thirty-six Millbrook Road... oh, sorry, sixty-three Millbrook Road! I always reverse those two digits when I am rushing.

script.text: Sixty-three Millbrook Road, all confirmed inside the town boundary. Now, which of our allotment sites were you hoping for?
I walked past North Orchard the other day and loved the fruit trees, though I heard the waiting list there is quite long?
Yes, North Orchard has roughly a three-year wait at the moment. Over at South Meadow, however, we just cleared three overgrown plots and have spaces opening next month.
Oh, next month beats waiting three years! Please put me down for South Meadow instead.
Great choice, South Meadow gets brilliant afternoon sun. Would you like to apply for a full plot or a half plot?
Um, I was thinking a full plot... wait, how big is a full plot in square metres?
A full plot is around two hundred and fifty square metres, which takes about eight to ten hours of weeding and digging every week.
Oh, goodness, I work full time and this is my first garden! Let me start sensibly with a half plot instead.
Very wise, most beginners prefer a half plot. For fees, a full plot is £94 a year, whereas a half plot is £52 annually, and that already includes the £12 shared water charge.
script.ttsText: Very wise, most beginners prefer a half plot. For fees, a full plot is ninety-four pounds a year, whereas a half plot is fifty-two pounds annually, and that already includes the twelve-pound shared water charge.

script.text: Fifty-two pounds a year including water is a bargain! Is there any deposit for the site gate key?
Yes, there is a refundable £25 key deposit when you sign your tenancy agreement. If you ever need an extra spare key cut later, that costs £10 non-refundable.
script.ttsText: Yes, there is a refundable twenty-five pound key deposit when you sign your tenancy agreement. If you ever need an extra spare key cut later, that costs ten pounds non-refundable.

script.text: Right, £25 refundable deposit. Before we finish, could you tell me a bit about the site rules and facilities at South Meadow?
script.ttsText: Right, twenty-five pound refundable deposit. Before we finish, could you tell me a bit about the site rules and facilities at South Meadow?

script.text: Sure! There are shared dip tanks for filling watering cans every thirty metres. One strict rule to note: because South Meadow backs onto housing, bonfires are completely banned all year round. You will need to compost woody prunings or take them to the recycling centre.
No bonfires at all, fair enough. Does the council provide any free soil supplies for tenants?
Yes! Local tree surgeons tip free woodchips by the gate in autumn for paths, and every spring the council delivers a large heap of free compost for tenants to dig into their vegetable beds.
Free compost in spring will save me a fortune. And how often do you inspect the plots to make sure they are being looked after?
We carry out two inspections a year. We used to do the first one in April, though because of late spring frosts we shifted the first inspection to May, with a second check in September.
Okay, May and September. How much of the plot actually has to be planted by May?
Tenants may use up to 25 percent of the area for a small tool shed, seating, or paths, meaning at least 75 percent of the plot must be actively cultivated.
script.ttsText: Tenants may use up to twenty-five percent of the area for a small tool shed, seating, or paths, meaning at least seventy-five percent of the plot must be actively cultivated.

script.text: Seventy-five percent cultivated, got it. Thanks so much for walking me through everything, Rachel.
You are very welcome, Simon. I will post your tenancy pack to Millbrook Road this afternoon!

questionGroups.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

traps.explanationVi: Người gọi đánh vần từng chữ cái họ T-H-O-R-N-T-O-N.

questions.prompt: House number and street name before 'Road'

traps.explanationVi: Đọc đảo ngược số nhà thành 36 rồi sửa lại ngay thành 63 Millbrook Road.

questions.prompt: Allotment site selected by the applicant

traps.explanationVi: Thích North Orchard nhưng danh sách chờ ba năm nên đổi sang South Meadow.
Định chọn mảnh lớn (full) nhưng nghe diện tích quá rộng nên đổi sang nửa mảnh (half).

questions.prompt: Annual rent for a half plot including water (in pounds)

traps.explanationVi: 94 bảng là giá mảnh lớn, còn nửa mảnh gồm phí nước là 52 bảng mỗi năm.

questions.prompt: Refundable deposit for the gate key (in pounds)

traps.explanationVi: 10 bảng là phí cắt thêm chìa phụ không hoàn lại, tiền cọc chìa chính là 25 bảng.

questionGroups.instructions: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.prompt: Activity strictly banned on the allotment site all year round

traps.explanationVi: Lưu ý dạng số nhiều 'bonfires' (đốt lửa trại) bị cấm hoàn toàn quanh năm.

questions.prompt: Free gardening material delivered by the council in spring

traps.explanationVi: Dăm gỗ (woodchips) giao vào mùa thu, còn mùa xuân hội đồng giao phân ủ (compost).

questions.prompt: Month of the first yearly plot inspection

traps.explanationVi: Trước đây kiểm tra tháng Tư nhưng do sương giá muộn nên dời sang tháng Năm (May).

questions.prompt: Minimum percentage of the plot that must be cultivated

traps.explanationVi: 25% tối đa dành cho kho dụng cụ và lối đi, ít nhất 75% diện tích phải trồng trọt.
